Method of Attack: Abusing legitimate document signing services like Adobe Acrobat Sign and dochub.com to distribute malware
Redirecting victims to CAPTCHA-protected websites to add legitimacy
Distributing ZIP archives containing malicious payloads mixed with non-malicious files
Attack Vector: Malicious emails appearing to be from legitimate services
Links redirecting to malicious websites via legitimate document hosting platforms
Indicators of Compromise: Emails sent via Adobe Acrobat Sign
Documents hosted on Adobe’s servers and dochub.com
ZIP archives containing Redline malware and non-malicious executables from GTA V
